patterns.note: Asymmetrical editorial grid with prominent vertical line dividers and structural gridlines that mimic architectural blueprints.
High-contrast typographic pairing of an elegant, high-contrast serif for display headings and a wide, technical sans-serif/mono for labels and data.
Earthy, high-end luxury palette combining a deep warm charcoal background with a sandy, muted gold/beige for text, overlays, and structural lines.
A custom vertical-blind transition effect resembling barcode-like vertical slices that masks and reveals content during page loads or modal transitions.

technique_notes: Recreate the vertical-blind transition using GSAP and SVG masks or clip-paths, animating the scaleY or height of multiple staggered vertical strips to reveal the underlying content.
Implement a smooth-scrolling experience using Locomotive Scroll to match the slow, luxurious pace of the editorial layout.
Use CSS Grid to overlay architectural floor plans and interactive maps with absolute-positioned labels and fine-line borders.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings contrasted with tiny, wide-spaced uppercase sans-serif labels and technical numbers.
design_tokens.radius: sharp — clean, right-angled borders and boxes reflecting modern architectural lines, with occasional pill-shaped buttons for contrast.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and expansive, utilizing generous vertical margins and asymmetrical negative space to evoke a sense of luxury and breathing room.

standout: The standout feature is the architectural vertical-blind transition effect, which uses staggered vertical slices to mask and reveal content, perfectly mirroring the structural verticality of the real estate project.
